interpretation: The exact APK-default official login URL currently rejects a clean unauthenticated GET with HTTP 567 and a site-security-policy block message. This probe does not identify the provider from its response body. Earlier isolated Electron diagnostics recorded the EdgeOne marker; neither check authorizes impersonation, challenge forgery, or transfer of phone credentials.
impact: Authenticated desktop login and real account-write acceptance remain blocked. Guest reads, protocol mocks and isolated UI checks do not substitute for those validations.
